# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 23 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Private Residential & Rentals

- **New home sales rebound to 3-month high in July 2026** - Developers sold 731 new private homes (excluding ECs) in July 2026, a 368.6% jump from June's 156 units and the strongest sales month since April. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/new-home-sales-rebound-to-3-month-high-as-july-launches-return/)

- **Condo rental prices and volumes both hit all-time highs in July 2026** - Singapore's condo rental market recorded simultaneous records in both rental prices and transaction volumes in July 2026, with the HDB rental market also strengthening over the same period. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-rental-prices-volumes-record-high-july-2026/)

- **Kallang Distripark could be redeveloped into up to 2,550 private homes** - URA's proposed Master Plan amendments, published on 14 August 2026, would convert the existing Kallang Distripark industrial site into a private housing precinct of potentially more than 2,000 homes near Geylang Bahru MRT. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/kallang-distripark-redevelopment-private-homes/)

## HDB Resale Records

- **58-year-old Queenstown HDB terrace house sells for record S$1.04M** - A rare HDB terrace house along Stirling Road became the most expensive 3-room flat by absolute price in Queenstown at S$1.04 million, despite having around 40 years of lease remaining. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/58-year-old-hdb-terrace-house-in-queenstown-sells-for-record-s1-04m/)

- **Clementi Peaks unit sets new 3-room HDB resale record for the town at S$896K** - A Clementi Peaks flat transacted at S$896,000, setting a new 3-room HDB resale record for Clementi — notably before the development reached its Minimum Occupation Period. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/clementi-peaks-first-resale-breaks-3rm-hdb-record-at-s896k/)
